principles: Every edge must reference apps that exist in application-portfolio.csv
Killing any app must produce a defensible downstream-impact count
Mix of clean modern edges and brittle legacy edges (TIBCO/direct_db pockets)
Include SaaS-to-SaaS edges (Workday ↔ Okta, ServiceNow ↔ DataDog, etc.)
Include cross-region edges where realistic (us-east-1 ↔ us-west-2)
Include cross-cloud edges where realistic (AWS ↔ GCP for ML, AWS ↔ Azure for M365 adjacency)
